d:
Dipavli yani dipon ka utsav. yah keval patakhe phorne, mithaiyan khane aur ghar sajane ka tyohar nahin hai, balki jivan ke andhkar ko dur kar sukh, samriddhi aur prakash ki or barhne ka aadhyatmik avsar bhi hai. is din mata lakshmi aur bhagvan ganesh ki puja ka vishesh vidhan hai.
